description_html:
A bright third floor flat one bedroom flat (known as Type F2C). With south facing views from the middle of the block over the quiet landscaped podium providing a picturesque view of the city skyline. The reception room is open plan to the kitchen with a full width, full height window and door which leads to the balcony. The bedroom also looks inwards over the podium with a fitted cupboard. The separate bathroom has been preserved in original condition.

Kitchen
Original kitchen open plan to living area, wall and base units, stainless steel worktop and sink, Garchey waste disposal system, two ring electric hob, low level fridge.

Bedroom
With sliding window to south aspect overlooking landscaped podium level and water features, original fitted storage with original concertina doors, carpeted floor.

Entrance Hall
With service lockers and entry-phone.

Living Room
Full height/full width window with sliding door to balcony/fire exit, overlooking landscaped podium area and water features, carpeted floor.

Bathroom
Original white suite, bath with shower attachment, low level WC, wash basin, tiled walls and floor, wide inset wall mirror and wall mounted medicine cabinet.

Bunyan Court ideally located for access to Barbican tube station as well as the Farringdon Elizabeth line station. Residents have convenient access to the Hammersmith & City, Metropolitan and Circle lines.

Tenure: Leasehold Lease Years Remaining: 170
Service Charge: £4,818 (Yearly)
Annual Ground Rent: £0
Council Tax Band: D
